text:
maria: seeing a cluster of Xid/ECC errors originating from rack18 nodes (gpu06-09). They started around 02:10 UTC and are still increasing. Suspect a bad manufacturing batch, numbers are correlated by serial prefix.
jon: can you paste the alert summary? :thinking:
maria: alert summary from monitoring:
```
ALERT GPU ECC RATE HIGH: rack18 (hosts r18-n[02-12])
- affected: r18-n06,r18-n07,r18-n08,r18-n09
- avg ECC errs/min: 14 -> 47 over last 30m
- Xid events: 12 in 40m
``` 
leo: running a quick `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC` across the four hosts now.
anya: have we drained any pods/containers off those nodes yet?
maria: not yet, wanted triage first. if this is progressive we should cordon/drain soon.
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1863, severity P2. Automated node checks scheduled.
jon: thanks. leo, paste diag.
leo: diag dump (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-17 02:22:11] GPU06 ECC correctable: 3
[2026-03-17 02:24:37] GPU07 ECC correctable: 9
[2026-03-17 02:30:02] GPU08 Xid: 5, driver reset
[2026-03-17 02:35:48] GPU09 ECC correctable: 13
NV bios serial prefixes: 0xA7B-0xA7F across cards
``` 
maria: serial prefixes match a vendor shipment we received in Jan. @vendor-eng can you pull the lot / manufacturing date for those serials?
vendor-eng: got it — pulling lot data now. preliminary: same lot (lot# 2101-45), manufactured week 51. Passing it to HW team.
anya: ops impact — if we drain all four nodes we'll drop ~120T FLOPS available for GPU jobs; scheduling will backfill with Dedicated spare pool but job latency will spike. Cost-wise we'll burn burst capacity.
jon: proposal: cordon r18-n06 and r18-n09 (highest errs) now, run extended stress + memtest on r18-n07 and r18-n08 to see short-term stability. If they fail within 6 hours, RMA whole set.
leo: agree. also snapshot the kv cache dumps and core dumps for any driver resets.
ops-bot: initiated drain for r18-n06 -> pods evicted (20 pods), rescheduled to dedicated-burst-2. Estimated drain time 8m.
maria: thanks. I'll open an RMA pre-authorization ticket with procurement and tag serials.
jon: quick check — any firmware downgrades/driver changes in last month on that rack?
leo: no config changes recorded in infra-audit for those hosts. drivers on all are 525.85.05.
maria: vendor-eng said HW team wants full hw logs and `lspci -vvv` for each failing card.
vendor-eng: can you attach the `/var/log/nvml.log` and `dmesg` excerpts. we'll triage with factory.
anya: capacity plan: I'll spin up two additional dedicated nodes in us-west-2 for 24 hours to compensate; projected extra cost ~$1.6k/day. Approve?
jon: fine for P2; Maria, loop in finance for usage rebill if needed.
maria: done. created ticket FIN-2026-43 to track cost.
leo: memtest running on r18-n07/r18-n08 now. ETA ~4h. I'm also dumping serials to the RMA doc.
sre-bot: Update: r18-n06 drained and quarantined. Monitoring shows drop in on-host error rate but global rack still elevated due to remaining nodes.
jon: if memtest passes on the other two, do we run staged replacements or full-batch RMA? I'm leaning to replacing the whole lot to avoid recurrence.
vendor-eng: factory policy: if 2/4 units in a lot fail within 30 days of each other, they consider lot degradation and will authorize batch replace. Need formal failure logs and serial list.
maria: action items: 1) leo to attach hw logs + lspci + nvml logs for all 4 cards (due in 2h) 2) jon to coordinate drain schedule for remaining nodes 3) anya to spin up capacity and track cost 4) I will open RMA precheck with vendor + procurement. Will update INC-2026-1863 with evidence.
anya: noted. spinning capacity now.
leo: hw logs attached to INC-2026-1863. memtest on n07 shows increased ECC after 2h (failing trend). n08 still stable.
maria: based on memtest result I'm authorizing RMA for the lot. jon please schedule rolling replacements to avoid mass interruption. prefer off-peak (0400-0800 UTC).
jon: scheduled rolling replacement for rack18 03/18 04:00-08:00 UTC. will use spare pool and 1-for-1 replacements, drain->swap->verify->reintroduce.
vendor-eng: received RMA request, case #RMA-84211. factory dispatched replacement units, ETA 5 business days. We'll expedite if you provide full failure logs (you did, thank you).
maria: thanks everyone. postmortem plan: collect pre/post latency/cost delta, evaluate if we should increase spare pool or vendor SLAs for lot-based replacement. I'll draft initial RCA in doc and tag this thread.
anya: also recommend adding a metric to correlate ECC rate with serial/manuf-lot automatically.
leo: +1 to automation. could add a small agent that tags GPUs with lot ID into metrics pipeline.
jon: will run replacement and post-step health checks. funneling follow-ups into INC-2026-1863.
maria: closing triage here. please update the incident with any new failures. :thumbsup:
